topic: Day 15 — reel — The chapter you'll be grateful for is probably the hardest one right now
text: The hardest chapter becomes the one you're [grateful] for.
caption:
People rarely look back fondly on the easy stretches. The chapters they're proudest of are almost always the hardest ones.

Follow for one of these a day.
